components.name: Dialog
components.title: ui/base/Dialog
warnings: snap measured button[data-slot="dialog-trigger"], a closed trigger, rather than Dialog. What it opens renders only while open, usually in a portal outside the story's root, so the Figma component would be the trigger. To measure the content, have the story snap renders (the Default story, or else the first) render Dialog open, with defaultOpen for example: snap measures open content that carries data-slot="dialog-content" or that the trigger's aria-controls names.
